mod.name: SRO Catenary+ (Sawyer)
mod.author: quadub
mod.desc: v1.1. Stormworks Railway Overhaul with a Soviet / Russian style 25 kV overhead line (visual) on every track of the Sawyer mainland, after the Soviet standard drawings: concrete poles with earthed cantilevers and glass insulator strings, direct and reverse registration arms, zigzagged contact wire on droppers and spring stays, anchor sections with overlaps on traverses, tension weights, middle anchors, DPR line on the field side, portals with lattice girders, console posts and working ladders, wires through truss bridges. Includes the whole base SRO (3D rails and sleepers on every railway tile, smoothed curves, kilometre posts, track graph raised by 28 cm): use it instead of SRO, not together with it.
